title: Migrate fully registered runtime-derived OpenAPI paths to reviewed references

phases.objective: Replace an existing inline Support Ticket runtime-derived path item with its reviewed registry reference only when the complete path and every method are source-bound, fully registered, and structurally safe to remove.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the precise registry writer against a root OpenAPI document that still contains a fully registered runtime-derived inline Support Ticket path.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The complete inline path becomes the exact reviewed local path-item reference, check mode is idempotent, and any partial or path-level-augmented contract remains blocked without mutation.
steps: Create a root OpenAPI fixture with one precise runtime-derived Support Ticket operation.
Register the exact method and path to one reviewed local path-item reference.
Verify source, authorization profile, security alternatives, operation identity, response presence, and consequential classification.
Remove the complete inline path block and compose the reviewed reference without reformatting unrelated paths.
Run check mode and then submit a path-level-augmented variant to prove fail-closed behavior.
assertions: Only paths whose complete method set equals the registry method set are replaceable.
Every replaceable registry entry is sourced from routes/supportTicketRoutes.js and maps to the same path-item reference.

Every current operation has canonical runtime provenance, recognized authorization metadata, matching security, a generated operation identity, responses, and the generator consequential classification.
Path-level keys, missing methods, extra methods, wrong sources, wrong security, and partial registration remain conflicts.
The writer reports the number and identities of runtime-derived registry paths replaced.
A second check reports no drift and the unsafe case leaves the source document unchanged.

phases.objective: Remove the compatibility migration once every supported root OpenAPI branch uses reviewed registry references.
Detect registry and root-path drift without widening replacement authority beyond complete source-bound Support Ticket paths.
This repository-only OpenAPI composition repair has no external canary target.
Production deployment and runtime verification remain outside this repository-only contract migration.
